scope: PDF delivery, structure, glyphs and rendering; not full learning, student-comprehension, physical-device, or user acceptance.

initialProblem.cause: The portal Vite configuration disabled public files for both development and builds. Missing PDF URLs fell back to index.html.

glyphCorrections.method: Pinned licensed Unicode font fallback only for characters unsupported by the normal handout font.

limitations: Opening/rendering and transport checks do not establish a complete scientific or teaching review of every lab.
Generated reports used 47 fresh drafts and two existing synthetic completed-attempt fixtures. The audit did not replay 49 complete student workflows.
Previously assigned immutable releases were retained; old versions with the historical glyph defects are not rewritten. New local launches for the three affected labs select the corrected release.
